verdict.rationale: Mercury's own site says card spend earns unlimited cashback that is automatically deposited into the account, with no manual redemption or points [mercury-docs-8], and specifies a 1.5% rate on credit card spend [mercury-docs-38]. Together these cover both the earning and the no-redemption parts of the story. Missing for 10: first-party detail on deposit cadence and eligibility terms, and independent or hands-on confirmation that cashback actually arrives automatically.
